races.name: Hazelton Mountford Insurance Brokers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Rebel Tribesman
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven class who has been narrowly beaten in two recent starts at Sedgefield, perfectly positioned to track the leader
runners_data.comment: Just touched off when a short-priced favourite in a couple of Sedgefield maidens.
runners_data.spotlight: Won a bumper at Aintree last May; changed hands subsequently and has just been touched off when a short-priced favourite in a couple of Sedgefield maidens over 2m1f since switching to hurdles; steps up in trip and looks the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Mr Rafiki
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who showed improved form last time at Ffos Las after wind surgery, needs the pace to collapse
runners_data.comment: Stayed on well when fourth in a Ffos Las maiden last month on hurdles debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Last of four in a Ludlow bumper in October; had wind surgery subsequently and stayed on well when fourth of ten finishers in a Ffos Las maiden (2m4f, good to soft) last month on hurdles debut; that was a step in the right direction but more is required here.

runners_data.name: Bathara
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who won a bumper here but struggled over hurdles, will control the pace without pressure
runners_data.comment: Landed bumper here last October but has cut little ice in his two starts over hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: Landed bumper around here last October but has cut little ice in his two starts over hurdles; this looks easier but he needs to start producing.

runners_data.name: Royal Rocket
runners_data.note: Prominent racer improving with each run, trainer Emma Lavelle in decent form with a 2/9 strike rate
runners_data.comment: Stepped up on his hurdles debut to finish third in a Taunton novice last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Stepped up on his hurdles debut at Chepstow to finish third of seven in a Taunton novice (2m3f, good) last month; is going the right way and holds claims, but his best chance of success will be in handicaps.

runners_data.name: Blue's Secret Gem
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who flopped on hurdles debut at Fakenham just 16 days ago, may improve but faces a tactical disadvantage
runners_data.comment: Finished last of seven on hurdles debut at Fakenham 16 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed ability when in the frame in a couple of bumpers but finished last of seven on hurdles debut at Fakenham (2m4f, good) 16 days ago; may not come into her own until she is qualified for handicaps.

runners_data.name: The Craftymaster
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making hurdles debut with solid flat credentials, showed promise when third at Hereford last time
runners_data.comment: Made a pleasing hurdles debut when third in a Hereford maiden 15 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: A nine-time Flat winner over 1m6f-2m, he made a pleasing hurdles debut when third of five finishers (with stablemate Alex The Great 27l back) in a Hereford maiden (2m, good) 15 days ago; steps up in trip and holds place claims.

runners_data.name: Madmoiselle Moss
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with poor recent form and concerning fade pattern, trainer without a winner from two recent runners
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in a couple of bumpers and on hurdles debut last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in a couple of bumpers and on hurdles debut last month.

runners_data.name: Alex The Great
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with modest credentials who was beaten 27 lengths behind The Craftymaster at Hereford, hard to fancy
runners_data.comment: Beaten long way in two similar events over 2m at Hereford recently.
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time AW winner at a modest level on Flat; beaten long way in two similar events over 2m at Hereford recently; steps up in trip but easy to dismiss.

races.paceDynamic: Bathara will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him, allowing the O'Neill charge to dictate a measured gallop through the early stages. Royal Rocket and Rebel Tribesman are likely to track prominently behind the leader, while the substantial hold-up brigade of Mr Rafiki, Blue's Secret Gem, The Craftymaster, Madmoiselle Moss and Alex The Great will settle at the rear. With so many horses looking to come from behind and only one natural leader, this sets up perfectly for prominent racers and the pace-setter who can control the tempo without pressure. This tactical scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers over the crowded hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bathara Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Bathara maintains a steady gallop and sees out the trip strongly
scenarios.body: The leader faces no early pressure and can quicken when it matters, making it hard for the hold-up horses to close the gap. Rebel Tribesman tracking prominently is best placed to capitalize if Bathara falters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Tribesman and Royal Rocket press Bathara from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and exposes the weaker hold-up horses while the prominent pair have first run on the leader. Both have the class edge and are going the right way.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The Craftymaster and Mr Rafiki get their preferred scenario with a slow pace suiting their flat credentials and late kick. The front runners become sitting ducks for the classier closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Bathara goes too slowly and gets swamped by multiple challengers
scenarios.body: Too many hold-up horses converge simultaneously creating traffic problems and allowing a prominent racer to steal through. The tactical chaos favours those with early position.

watchPoints.text: Bathara could get an uncontested lead and prove hard to peg back if his stamina holds over this longer trip
Traffic problems likely in the home straight with five hold-up horses converging simultaneously from the back of the field
The Craftymaster making his hurdles debut could be overbet given his stablemate Alex The Great was well beaten in a similar event
Blue's Secret Gem returning quickly after just 16 days since a poor hurdles debut at Fakenham
Rebel Tribesman has been favourite twice recently at Sedgefield suggesting connections expect him to win soon

races.name: Logicor Grand Neighsional Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: The Moonlight Man

runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who showed his first form over fences when second of three in a weak contest at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) in March; had excuses when pulled up last time but does need to show improvement.

runners_data.spotlight: Landed back-to-back wins at Hereford over 3m1f on good this spring; found out in a higher grade twice since but back at his winning level and should run his race.

runners_data.spotlight: 1-28 under rules, his win coming over fences off this mark at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) last July; has been off since October and needs to hit the ground running.

runners_data.spotlight: Dual chase winner on slow ground (2m/2m3f) but out of sorts last term and has a lot to prove.

runners_data.name: Tom Desjy
runners_data.note: Front-runner carrying 7lb penalty but lightly raced with scope for improvement, though his known tendency to fade in the finish remains a major concern
runners_data.comment: Got off the mark on his third start over fences at Southwell nine days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark on his third start over fences at Southwell (3m, good) nine days ago; carries a 7lb penalty but this lightly raced type has scope for further improvement and will be hard to beat.

races.paceDynamic: Tom Desjy will lead from the flag with his confirmed front-running style, likely setting a sustainable gallop over this stamina test without serious pressure early. The prominent runners The Moonlight Man, Testflight, and John W Creasy will track within striking distance, while the hold-up quartet of Edgewell, Yes And Yes, and Grand Sabre will settle towards the rear. With only one dedicated leader and plenty of hold-up horses, this creates a tactical setup that strongly favours the patient types who can produce late finishing kicks over the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Tom Desjy sets his usual honest gallop without serious pace pressure
scenarios.body: The patient back-markers get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing speed in the final half-mile as the leader predictably fades. This tactical shape heavily favours the stamina-laden hold-up specialists who thrive when allowed to build momentum late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Holds Gamely
scenarios.trigger: If Tom Desjy gets his own way in front and finds more stamina than usual
scenarios.body: The front-runner maintains his advantage deeper into the race despite his known finishing limitations, holding off the late challengers who leave their run too late. His recent Southwell success suggests untapped stamina reserves over this longer trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners apply early pressure and quicken the tempo substantially
scenarios.body: The increased pace suits the horses positioned handy who can capitalize when Tom Desjy predictably weakens, while also setting up too strong a gallop for the hold-up horses to make up ground. This benefits those with tactical speed from prominent positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Tom Desjy fails to handle the step up in class and folds before halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl that turns into a sprint finish, suiting any horse with a turn of foot regardless of usual running style. This chaotic scenario opens the door for any runner with residual ability and recent form.

watchPoints.text: Tom Desjy's jumping under pressure in the final mile - if he makes mistakes when challenged, it could bring down trailing horses
Testflight's fitness after 211 days off - any signs of rustiness early will confirm he needs this run badly
Grand Sabre's response to first-time cheekpieces - if the headgear fails to spark improvement, his long absence becomes more concerning
The pace through the early stages - if Tom Desjy goes too fast early, it will set up the hold-up horses even more perfectly
Edgewell's jumping rhythm early - his recent wins came when settling well, so any early exuberance could compromise his chances

races.name: Mane Event: Logicor Cup Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.comment: Fourth at Fontwell on his return last month following a five-month break.
runners_data.spotlight: Has four wins over fences, including over C&D; encouraging fourth at Fontwell (2m3f, good) on his return last month following a five-month break but he's 2lb higher than his last winning mark.

runners_data.name: Rangatira Jack
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping down in grade, hasn't won for nearly a year but showed signs of life when second last time.

races.paceDynamic: Full Force Gale will set the pace from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field, creating a sustainable gallop throughout the 2m4f trip. Jack Doyen and King Of The Story will both be held up off the modest early pace, while Rangatira Jack may track closer but won't pressure the leader. The lack of pace pressure means Full Force Gale can dictate terms and kick when ready, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground from off a potentially steady tempo. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front-runners who can control the tempo without being harassed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Full Force Gale maintains control of the tempo without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The leader can time his effort perfectly and prove too strong when quickening off a controlled pace. The hold-up horses struggle to make sufficient inroads from off the modest gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold Up Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely steady and Jack Doyen gets the perfect ride
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old's superior finishing kick proves decisive as he sweeps past tired leaders in the final furlong. King Of The Story may also benefit from similar tactics if close enough.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tracking Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Rangatira Jack can sit handy without over-racing and Full Force Gale weakens
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets first run on the leaders and holds off the late challengers. His position throughout the race gives him the tactical advantage over both front and back runners.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Full Force Gale sets unsustainably fast fractions under pressure from Rangatira Jack
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes too strong and both leaders tie up badly in the final half-mile. This sets up a dramatic finish where stamina and late pace matter most.

watchPoints.text: Jack Doyen running just one day after his last race could show signs of fatigue in the closing stages
Full Force Gale needs to be allowed to dictate his own pace without early interference to be most effective
King Of The Story requires strong pace to aim at given his hold-up style and recent absence
Rangatira Jack must not get too keen tracking Full Force Gale or he'll compromise his finishing effort
The small field means less cover for the hold-up horses Jack Doyen and King Of The Story

runners_data.name: King Of The Road

races.paceDynamic: Crest Of Stars and King Of The Road will battle for the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to go at it from the off over this staying trip. The sustained pace they create should stretch the field and make it a true test of stamina at 2m5f. With multiple prominent runners like Champagne Twist, Norman Fletcher, Jimmy Hurdstrom and Il Va De Soi positioned close up, the pace will be honest throughout. This honest gallop strongly favors front-runners and prominent racers who can travel well in the first four, as the lone hold-up horse La Vish will struggle to recover the ground they'll need to find.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Crest Of Stars or King Of The Road can establish an uncontested lead early
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run and maintains their advantage up the hill, with the sustained pace finding out those trying to close from off the pace. Prominent runners fill the places but can't reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too hard and weaken in the straight
scenarios.body: A horse like Il Va De Soi or Champagne Twist can pick up the pieces, having tracked the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle. The class and recent form of these horses tells late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Speed Test
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders maintain their kick and neither gives an inch
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition where only the most genuine stayers survive, with Crest Of Stars looking better suited to the trip than King Of The Road. Norman Fletcher could emerge as the best of the rest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: La Vish gets the perfect setup to unleash her finishing kick from the back, though this scenario requires everything to fall perfectly for the lone closer. Even then, she'd need career-best form.

watchPoints.text: King Of The Road and Crest Of Stars disputing the lead too fiercely early could set this up for something tracking behind
Il Va De Soi attempting to make all again just 11 days after his last win - quick turnaround may catch up with him
La Vish's position turning for home will reveal if the pace has been strong enough to bring her into contention
Champagne Twist's jumping after 53 days off following that Uttoxeter unseating incident
Norman Fletcher's stamina reserves in the final furlong given his previous struggles beyond 2m4f

races.paceDynamic: This race lacks genuine early pace with only Buxted Reel, Louie The Legend and Onehundredneighty showing prominent tendencies, while six runners prefer to settle behind. Buxted Reel and Louie The Legend will likely share early duties at a steady gallop over this sharp 2m trip, creating an uncontested lead situation. The lack of pressure up front means the pace will be comfortable through the early stages, setting up a tactical finish where positioning matters more than raw speed. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed, as the hold-up horses face the difficult task of making up ground from too far back in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Buxted Reel and Louie The Legend get an easy lead as expected
scenarios.body: The comfortable pace allows the front pair to stay strong into the finish, with their superior tactical positions proving decisive. Hold-up horses struggle to close the gap from their deep positions in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing through mid-race pressure
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses with proven tactical ability who can position close enough to strike. Recent winner Allibaba and improving Louie The Legend benefit from their experience.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is extremely pedestrian and collapses completely
scenarios.body: The crawling gallop allows patient hold-up horses to get into contention despite their preferred style being compromised. Westerton and Karthala can use their finishing kicks to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Improvement Tale
scenarios.trigger: If the handicapper has got the weights wrong for improving types
scenarios.body: A lightly-raced improver or returning horse shows significant advancement from their last run. Babychino or the headgear-assisted Golly Gosh could spring a surprise.

watchPoints.text: Buxted Reel could struggle with the sustained nature of hurdle racing after 257 days off and AW Flat background
Market support for any of the hold-up horses would suggest connections expect a stronger pace than the evidence suggests
Louie The Legend's position turning for home will be crucial as his prominent style perfectly suits this race shape
Allibaba's ability to overcome the 9lb handicap rise and tactical disadvantage will test his Market Rasen winning form
Any early pressure on the leaders from Onehundredneighty would completely change the complexion of this contest

races.paceDynamic: Kingston Sunflower stands alone as the only confirmed front-runner, but hasn't run for 168 days and may lack match fitness to sustain the gallop. Four horses (Bluegrass, Forget The Way, Mojito Des Mottes, Chief Sunday) all want prominent positions early, creating congestion and potential traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up brigade of High Fibre, Brendas Asking, Unjeu Royal and Scintillante will benefit from this scenario, getting first run on horses caught in trouble. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can pick off faltering front-runners and avoid the prominent traffic jam.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kingston Sunflower fades or the prominent pack goes too fast early
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final half-mile as the early leaders pay for their exertions, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired front-runners. Fresh legs triumph over those who raced keenly in the congested prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet settle better than expected and Kingston Sunflower sets moderate fractions
scenarios.body: Bluegrass or Forget The Way get first run from their forward positions while the hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up. The winner emerges from those who raced handy throughout without getting caught in serious traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kingston Sunflower Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If the long-absent leader proves fitter than expected and the field allows her comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: Kingston Sunflower gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear when the field realizes too late that nobody is putting pressure on the front-runner. Her 4-5 record over hurdles suggests she knows how to win when getting her own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Kingston Sunflower stops quickly and the prominent pack goes too slowly, creating stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl with multiple horses still in contention turning for home, leading to a bunched finish where the best horse on the day wins regardless of tactics. Form and class become the deciding factors over race shape.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Kingston Sunflower's fitness after 168-day layoff - if she stops quickly the prominent pack will be going too fast trying to get to her
Watch Bluegrass, Forget The Way, Mojito Des Mottes and Chief Sunday for traffic problems as all four want the same prominent position early
Watch for Brendas Asking and Unjeu Royal getting strong late runs from off the pace if the early gallop is strong
Watch James Turner's 5lb claim on Chief Sunday - won't be enough to overcome poor form but could help if he bounces back
Watch the pace after 4 furlongs - if Kingston Sunflower is still traveling easily the field may have been too patient
